newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish March EU-harmonised CPI rises 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish March EU-harmonised CPI rises 0.8 pct.

text.p: The Finnish consumer price index harmonised to European Union standards rose 0.8 percent year-on-year in March after a 0.6 percent rise in February, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
According to SF's regular national method of calculation, Finnish consumer prices rose 0.6 percent year-on-year in March and rose 0.4 percent month-on-month, it said.

Four economists' average forecast for the national CPI figure had been for a 0.4 percent rise year-on-year and a 0.2 percent rise month-on-month. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
